STREET RULES

HOW TO PLAY

Land punches, slaps, and kicks to fill your special meter. When it glows, unleash your fighter’s special. Specials cannot be blocked. Your fighter is protected until the full special finishes; new attacks wait until then.

MOVE
A D or direction keys
JUMP / DOUBLE JUMP
W or SPACE
PUNCH / KICK
J / K
BLOCK BASIC ATTACKS
B
USE SPECIAL
L · full meter

Drag the left stick to move. Use the four round buttons to jump, punch, kick, or use your special. For Get It, Dr. No Bunnies, Smack Prince, and MooJa, the Slap button delivers an open-hand slap. For Can't Rap, the Punch button performs a microphone strike. Tap Jump again for a double jump; Get It, Loud Bull, FatBoi, Ice Spice, and HeHaw use normal double jumps, while Karate Fighter and Snitchy flip. Rotate your phone to play in portrait or landscape.

Rapid Punches switches to a white gi. Call the Cops brings a police car and three officers. Get It’s Live Performance pulls out a microphone and sends singing waves toward the opponent, ending in a cartoon explosion. Loud Bull walks with a bob-and-weave guard. His Giant Yell makes his mouth huge and blasts the opponent with sound. FatBoi waddles as he walks. For Bite & Toss, he bites a chicken wing first, then throws the bitten wing to damage his opponent. Ice Spice walks in a fighting guard. Munch grabs a nearby opponent for three giant-mouth cartoon chomps, then releases them. Stay close and catch them on the ground. Dr. No Bunnies uses the African Pride Belt Slap: move close, then land three protected, unblockable 16-damage strikes. “LASHES!” appears on each strike, and the third launches the opponent backward. HeHaw points forward to call Horse Power: a black stallion gallops across the stage and knocks her opponent backward. Can't Rap calls in eight small red-turban crew members who rush the opponent for eight protected, unblockable cartoon hits. Smack Prince dances as he moves. The Smack Upgrade puts him in a tuxedo beneath a bright spotlight, then delivers a powerful open-hand slap that sends a nearby opponent flying. Move close before activating. Baby Big Fists grows enormous fists and throws two punches, with an “mmm” speech bubble on each punch. The second hit launches the opponent backward. His fists shrink back to normal afterward. MooJa transforms into a cow and fires three milk missiles from her mouth, then changes back. Jump over the missiles to evade them. Cranes walks elegantly and lets out an angry shout to summon Elevator Drop. Move out of the glowing landing area before the elevator falls; jumping in place will not avoid it.
